jobs.title: Compliance Specialist - Operations & Risk
jobs.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.

Join our Qrew!

Here is how the Compliance Specialist role will impact our business:

As a key member of EQT's Compliance Operations & Risk team, the Compliance Specialist will execute day-to-day Know Your Customer (KYC) operations within EQT's Third Party Diligence program for LNG & LPG counterparties and approved high-risk exceptions — tracking diligence requests, resolving missing counterparty documentation, and performing sanctions screening and Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and supporting Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD). This role is responsible for maintaining scalable, consistent throughput on high-volume, recurring diligence obligations, administering Compliance Operations & Risk case intake and reporting, and maintaining data quality in EQT's compliance systems (Salesforce). As the Third Party Diligence program matures, the role will expand to executing compliance control testing.

The Compliance Specialist, Operations & Risk responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Execute day-to-day KYC operations within EQT’s Third Party Diligence program for LNG & LPG counterparties and approved high-risk exceptions, applying the program’s established risk tiers and thresholds.

- Track open diligence requests, follow up on missing counterparty documents, publish and hand off request notices, and maintain dashboard-based status reporting on outstanding diligence items.

- Manage outreach for KYC packets and maintain complete, accurate Salesforce records of counterparty documentation.

- Perform sanctions screening and apply risk tiers, and support Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on elevated-risk counterparties under the direction of the Manager, Compliance Operations & Risk.

- Run the ongoing rescreening cadence, perform Customer Due Diligence (CDD) refreshes, complete annual certifications, and escalate elevated-risk and potential true matches to the Manager, Compliance Operations & Risk for review and escalation to Legal as required.

- Administer intake, logging, and triage of Compliance Operations & Risk cases, maintaining case records for completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness.

- Maintain program metrics and reporting, and maintain Salesforce data quality and reporting within established standards.

As the Third Party Diligence program matures, responsibilities will expand to include:

- Execute compliance control tests under the Compliance Operations & Risk control testing process, documenting test results and supporting evidence.

- Track remediation of control testing findings through closure.

- Coordinate with third-party control testers, who independently test the diligence controls this role operates.

Required Experience and Skills:

- Bachelor's degree or relevant work experience.

- 0–3 years of experience in compliance, risk, audit, legal, or related field.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with comfort managing a high volume of concurrent diligence requests and deadlines.

- Clear written communication, including recurring status reporting and direct outreach to counterparties.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

- Direct experience with sanctions screening, KYC/EDD/CDD, or third-party diligence operations.

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working in data, spreadsheets, and reporting tools (Salesforce experience a plus).

- Interest in compliance control testing or internal audit, including an understanding of control design and test documentation.

- Comfort using AI and automation tools to improve efficiency and scale recurring processes, consistent with EQT’s AI Usage Policy.

- Ability to follow structured, defined processes consistently and at volume, while identifying opportunities for improvement.

- High integrity and sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential counterparty information.

Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states:  California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans.

jobs.title: Associate Strategic Execution
jobs.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.

Join our Qrew!

The Associate Strategic Execution plays a key role in evaluating and executing M&A, asset & divestiture, and energy transition opportunities that shape the company's strategic direction. This role combines rigorous financial analysis with hands-on transaction support - from building valuation models and stress-testing scenarios, to coordinating due diligence and shaping the investment theses presented to senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings a strong analytical foundation, sound business judgment, and the communication skills to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Success in this role requires equal comfort working independently on detailed financial modeling and collaborating across internal and external teams to drive deals from screening through execution and post-close performance tracking.

T he Associate Strategic Execution responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Lead financial modeling, valuation, and scenario analysis for M&A, A&D, energy transition, and other strategic investment opportunities.

- Independently identify and structure analytical frameworks that frame risk, reward, and strategic fit.

- Support transaction execution by coordinating financial, technical, commercial, and legal due diligence efforts across internal and external stakeholders.

- Prepare and present investment screening materials and recommendations to senior leadership.

- Develop and defend investment theses through data-driven analysis and clear, concise communication.

- Conduct industry, market, and competitive research to inform opportunity evaluation and strategic decision-making.

- Contribute to the development of investment cases, negotiation support materials, and post-closing performance tracking.

Required Experience and Skills:

- 4+ years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or technical energy experience.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, or related fields.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and financial analysis tools.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex analyses clearly.

- Strong project management skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Knowledge of the Energy industry landscape and market dynamics.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

- Experience using financial databases. (e.g., Capital IQ, FactSet, Bloomberg)

- Demonstrated knowledge of commercial, capital markets and corporate finance principles.

- Experience preparing and presenting materials to senior executives.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans.
